title: XAttention: Block Sparse Attention with Antidiagonal Scoring
original_abstract: Long-Context Transformer Models (LCTMs) are vital for real-world applications but suffer high computational costs due to attention's quadratic complexity. Block-sparse attention mitigates this by focusing computation on critical regions, yet existing methods struggle with balancing accuracy and efficiency due to costly block importance measurements. In this paper, we introduce XAttention, a plug-and-play framework that dramatically accelerates long-context inference in Transformers models using sparse attention. XAttention's key innovation is the insight that the sum of antidiagonal values (i.e., from the lower-left to upper-right) in the attention matrix provides a powerful proxy for block importance. This allows for precise identification and pruning of non-essential blocks, resulting in high sparsity and dramatically accelerated inference. Across comprehensive evaluations on demanding long-context benchmarks—including RULER and LongBench for language, VideoMME for video understanding, and VBench for video generation—XAttention achieves accuracy comparable to full attention while delivering substantial computational gains. We demonstrate up to 13.5× acceleration in attention computation. These results underscore XAttention's ability to unlock the practical potential of block sparse attention, paving the way for scalable and efficient deployment of LCTMs in real-world applications.

gaps_and_improvements.gap: Fixed stride pattern may miss optimal sparsity patterns
gaps_and_improvements.improvement: Adaptive stride selection based on content characteristics
gaps_and_improvements.description: Instead of fixed stride S=8 or S=16, use content-aware stride selection that adapts based on attention pattern density and complexity

runtime_analysis.improved: [L²/S_dynamic, S_dynamic, d] + [L²·density_adaptive, d, 1] where S_dynamic ∈ {4,8,16,32} based on content entropy

gaps_and_improvements.implementation: Compute attention entropy per block to select optimal stride, adding O(L log L) preprocessing overhead

gaps_and_improvements.gap: Single antidiagonal pattern may not capture all important patterns
gaps_and_improvements.description: Combine antidiagonal, diagonal, and vertical patterns with learned weights to improve block importance prediction

runtime_analysis.improved: [L²/S, S, d] × 3 patterns + [3, 3, 1] weight matrix multiplication = [L²/S, S, d] with 3× compute but better accuracy

gaps_and_improvements.implementation: Learn 3×3 weight matrix for pattern combination using small validation set, amortized over inference

gaps_and_improvements.gap: Threshold selection requires manual tuning per task
gaps_and_improvements.improvement: Automatic threshold prediction using gradient-based optimization
gaps_and_improvements.description: Replace dynamic programming with differentiable threshold prediction using validation loss gradients

runtime_analysis.baseline: O(M·H) DP computation where M=1000, H=attention heads
runtime_analysis.improved: O(log(1/ε)) gradient steps = [log(1/ε), H, 1] where ε=0.01, typically 5-10 steps vs 1000

gaps_and_improvements.implementation: Use straight-through estimator for threshold gradients, reducing optimization from 1000 to ~10 steps

gaps_and_improvements.improvement: Hardware-aware block sizing and memory layout
gaps_and_improvements.description: Optimize block sizes based on GPU shared memory and tensor core dimensions

runtime_analysis.baseline: [L, L, d] with poor memory locality
runtime_analysis.improved: [L²/S_hw, S_hw, d] where S_hw ∈ {64,128} aligns with GPU warp size and shared memory

gaps_and_improvements.implementation: Autotune block sizes based on GPU architecture (A100: 128, H100: 256) for optimal memory coalescing

gaps_and_improvements.gap: Limited to prefill stage, no decoding optimization
gaps_and_improvements.improvement: Extend to decoding with KV-cache aware sparsity
gaps_and_improvements.description: Apply antidiagonal scoring to KV-cache entries during decoding phase

runtime_analysis.improved: [L_cache²/S, S, d] per step where L_cache grows with sequence length

gaps_and_improvements.implementation: Maintain running antidiagonal scores for KV-cache, update incrementally with O(L) complexity

gaps_and_improvements.gap: No handling of variable-length sequences efficiently
gaps_and_improvements.description: Skip computation on padded tokens by integrating padding mask into block selection

runtime_analysis.improved: [L_actual²/S, S, d] where L_actual ≤ L_padded, reducing computation by padding ratio

gaps_and_improvements.implementation: Integrate padding mask into antidiagonal scoring to skip padded regions entirely

innovative_points.explanation: Revolutionary insight that antidiagonal sums capture both vertical and slash attention patterns efficiently
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Reduces block importance computation from O(B²) to O(B) per block

innovative_points.explanation: First sparse attention method that requires no retraining or fine-tuning
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Eliminates [L, L, d] × epochs training cost entirely

innovative_points.explanation: Uses dynamic programming to optimize thresholds individually for each attention head
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Reduces density from 26.13% to 20.97% with same accuracy

innovative_points.explanation: Uses strided antidiagonal sampling to reduce computation while maintaining pattern coverage
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Reduces scoring computation by stride factor S (8-16× reduction)

innovative_points.explanation: Successfully applied to language, video understanding, and video generation tasks
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Single method achieves [L, L, d] → [L²·density, d, 1] across all modalities
